rolling_summary: Morning knee stiffness lasting 2 weeks. Diagnosed as Vata‑pradhana Sandhivata (early osteoarthritis). Advised warm ginger decoction twice daily, Triphala with warm milk at night, gentle knee massage with Mahanarayan Taila, Yograj Guggulu 500 mg

turns.user: I have morning stiffness in my knees for 2 weeks
turns.ai: It looks like the stiffness points to Vata‑pradhana Sandhivata, an early stage of osteoarthritis. Warm ginger decoction taken twice daily, a teaspoon of Triphala powder with warm milk at night, and a gentle daily massage of the knees with Mahanarayan Taila can pacify Vata and ease the joints. Yograj Guggulu 500 mg after meals for a fortnight supports the cartilage and reduces crepitus. Keep your diet warm and oily – favor cooked vegetables, mung dal, ghee, and spiced soups, and avoid cold, raw, dry foods, excess caffeine and night‑shade vegetables.
